name: Create Poppet
description:
Choose a creature you can see. You fashion a tiny doll that crudely resembles the creature. For the next minute, while you are holding the doll, once per round, you may spend a half action to achieve one of the following effects, choosing each effect only once:

  • The creature regains HEART Endurance.

  • The creature takes +1d to a skill of your choice.

  • The creature clears a Condition.

When you use the doll for the third time, it is destroyed, leaving its heart behind in the form of a seed. Until the spell ends, any creature can eat the seed as a half action. A creature that does so gains 2d8 temporary Endurance.

improvements.name: Malicious Intent
improvements.description:
You may choose from these additional effects:

  • The creature takes 1 damage.

  • The creature takes -1d to a skill of your choice for 1 round.

  • The creature checks a Condition.
